description: Rehabilitation Project of the Sluice Tower, Sluice Barrel and remaining parts of the Senanayake Samudraya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-09-03 for the selection of a contractor for the reconstruction or repair of the sluice tower and the reconstruction or repair of the sluice barrel of the Senanayake Samudraya, following the international bidding method, and for making the necessary provisions available for the same. Subsequently, considering the complexity of the reconstruction work and the special technical skills required to prepare relevant specifications, it has been identified that the said procurement should be carried out in two phases. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to implement the said project as follows:

Phase 01 - Selection of a suitable consultancy firm under the Quality Based Selection method following the international competitive bidding procedure to prepare the relevant conceptual design and procurement documents for the renovation or reconstruction of the sluice tower, sluice barrel and ancillary parts.


Phase 02 - Selection of a suitable contracting firm for the construction work under the international competitive bidding method, based on the conceptual design and relevant procurement documents prepared by the consultancy firm selected under Phase 01.
